What you gain

Being found on Google

Your website is ready for Google from day one: the right words, one page per service, a fast website on phones.

Looking as professional as the big names

A well-made website in your name, with your business email address if you like. Your customers take you seriously straight away.

No more worrying about any of it

Domain name, hosting, updates, backups: I take care of it. You get on with your trade.

Talking to a real person

A question, a change? You write to me from your client area, and I reply myself.

How it works

Four steps, and nothing technical for you.

  1. 1

    You put your website together

    You choose your website and your options in two minutes, and the price appears. You pay 25% when you order.

  2. 2

    I prepare your website

    I register your domain name and ask you the right questions. Lia helps me with the layout and the first drafts of the text.

  3. 3

    You approve the preview

    You see your website before anyone else. You tell me what to change, and I fix it.

  4. 4

    I put it online and look after it

    Your website is online, safe and up to date. A change? You ask for it from your client area.

After the launch

You ask, I take care of it

Opening hours, a price, a photo to change? Write it from your client area, with a photo if needed. Small edits are done with Lia in a few minutes, with a preview for you to approve. For everything else, it is me, by hand.

The subscription includes 100 tokens a month for these edits and for the tools, and one change by me each quarter. Need more? You buy extra tokens as you use them. An article, a review session together or an extra change can be ordered one at a time.
